features.title: State-in-prompt vs. file-based board
verification: uv run ruff check src/ tests/
Run scenarios/examples/intelligence.yaml for one complete step with --provider subprocess and verify proposal, critique, resolution, checkpoint, and report artifacts.
evidence: 7 focused board-access tests cover defaults, invalid combinations, provider capability and turn-budget checks, flat file mode, and population file mode.
415 total tests passing and ruff clean as of 2026-09-21.
Authenticated Claude CLI completed a fresh one-step intelligence simulation with 4 proposals, 1 critique, 1 resolution, an 8-field state delta, and a step-1 checkpoint.
features.notes: Scenario-level board_access selects embedded or files. Embedded mode remains the default, passes state inline, and falls back to artifacts when stdout is invalid. File mode omits board contents from prompts, requires a workspace-capable provider with at least three tool-use turns, and treats artifact files as authoritative. Both flat and population loops share the same policy seam; file mode is rejected with step batching because batched responses use a stdout step-index contract. Tracking issue: #66.
